GSEA running-enrichment curve

Source: R/fig_enrich.R
fig_gsea_curve.Rd

Wraps fgsea::plotEnrichment() for a single pathway, restyled to match RNAflow's theme.

Usage

fig_gsea_curve(
  res,
  pathway_genes,
  rank_by = "stat",
  title = NULL,
  line_color = "#1D9E75",
  mode = c("exploration", "publication")
)

Arguments

res

DE results data.frame

pathway_genes

character vector of genes in the pathway

rank_by

ranking metric passed to rank_genes()

title

plot title (e.g. the pathway name)

line_color

color of the running enrichment line

mode

"exploration" or "publication"

Value

a ggplot2 object
